narr: A cutoff low produced multiple days of heavy rain. Hazards that resulted included gusty severe winds, flooding, funnel clouds, hail, and tree damage.
ev: Flooding of all lanes occurred at East 4th street in Winnemucca near the intersection of Reinhardt street. This resulted from continuous heavy rain. Road remains closed as of 13:00 LT 9/4/23.

All lanes have been closed on NV-722 from MM 41.51 (intersection of NV-722 with US-50 near Austin), to MM 13. Heavy Rain has caused standing water and flooding in the roadway. Road remains closed as of 13:00 LT 9/4/23.
Storms training over the same area led to areal flooding over SR-305 in Lander County. The road was temporarily closed between MM 60 to MM 40.
Flooding caused by heavy rain closed NV-361 from Gabbs, NV south to US-95. Road has reopened 1 lane as of the same time the following day.
